records.synonyms_note: Mimosa quadrivalvis var. latidens (Small) Barneby, Morongia latidens Small and Schrankia latidens are synonyms. ITIS accepts species rank; WFO lists the combination and WCVP-linked data.
records.concept_caution: Historical broad Mimosa quadrivalvis identifications cannot automatically be reassigned to M. latidens. POWO species page not independently retrieved; preserve ITIS/WFO authority provenance.
records.handoff: Preserve existing canonical and prior evidence; no range, media, or other lane changes.
